messages:
maria: Quick sync  we moved the analyst embargo to 2026-04-06 09:00 PT. Need checklist for the dry run tomorrow and who gets live demo creds during briefings. Who can own the fact-check doc?

trent: I can own the fact-check doc. Requesting that we include a short latency/cost table and the raw test config so analysts can validate claims.

ravi: Product prefers giving analysts a short live demo + interactive Q&A. Press gets recorded walkthrough after embargo lifts. Live demo implies ephemeral demo creds and a read-only dataset.

julia: Legal note  any absolute "X% faster" claims need the test config and confidence interval. If we add "up to" phrasing it's easier to clear. I'll review once the fact-check doc has the numbers.

andrew: Ops can spin ephemeral demo instances. Suggest we use time-limited API keys (48-hr) and restrict to analyst emails. Need the list 24h in advance to automate provisioning. Will add CSR and IP allowlist to the runbook.

maria: Action items: 1) @trent fact-check doc + latency table (due 6pm PT today). 2) @ravi prepare short demo script + sample queries (due noon tomorrow). 3) @andrew demo provisioning script + key expiry policy (due 3pm tomorrow). 4) @julia legal to sign off on claim language after doc posted (due EOD tomorrow).

trent: Will assemble doc. Quick question  do we want an embargoed FAQ for analysts (basic Qs + answers) so they don't need to bug the PR team during briefings?

maria: Yes, please add an FAQ section in the fact-check doc. Keep answers short. Also include one-sentence customer quote attribution template.

ravi: Demo script draft: 1) show baseline model latency, 2) toggle batching+cache and show change, 3) show cost units before/after. Will include exact commands and a small results table.

andrew: For automation I'll produce a small Terraform snippet + key rotation step. Example key TTL: 48h. Will output a list of commands we can run during analyst slot to repro numbers.

embargo-bot: Reminder: upload the fact-check doc by 18:00 PT for same-day legal review.

julia: If the fact-check doc contains raw numbers, add the line: "Results based on internal test suite; customer results may vary." Approving headline with qualifier: "Redwood Inference reduces per-token latency and cost in our test suite."

maria: Draft headline options (marketing): 1) "Redwood Inference slashes inference latency and unit costs (internal tests)" 2) "Engineered for production: lower latency and lower token costs" Please vote or suggest edits.

trent: Vote 1 but change parentheses to "based on internal tests".

ravi: I like #2 for press, #1 for analyst briefings (technically richer).

andrew: Ops note  make sure the demo logs redact customer PII and include a static seed for deterministic outputs.

maria: Great. I'll merge inputs into the fact-check doc. When @trent posts it, @julia will do a quick legal pass and then I'll send embargoed invites with demo access instructions.

trent: Posted fact-check doc link in thread and added FAQ + latency table. Sent preliminary analyst list (names + emails).

julia: Reviewing now  small wording tweak suggested in doc comment re: "average" vs "median". Otherwise looks good.

andrew: Provisioning scripts ready. Will test on a staging slot at 4pm PT and post logs.

maria: Everything looking healthy. Embargo metadata set to 2026-04-06T16:00Z (09:00 PT). I'll schedule invites for analysts with the demo key instructions and include the FAQ. Thanks team. :v:

embargo-bot: Scheduled embargo notification to press list at 08:50 PT on 2026-04-06.

maria: Closing thread; ping here if a blocker appears. We'll run the dry run at 4pm PT tomorrow.
